long_biography.plain_text:
Sendrine Pichueque Laurent helped establish Cecilou Invest as a family company, becoming its first managing director alongside Jean-Jacques Laurent as president. Her appointment gave her authority to direct and represent the business. She stepped down in 2022 when the shareholders approved its sale to Holcim France.

That year, Sendrine contributed her rights to income from Cecilou Invest shares to Les Frangines, another family company. Jean-Jacques, Cécilia and Mary-Lou Laurent also transferred share interests. The exchange preserved Sendrine’s income rights in the receiving company, whose management was entrusted to Cécilia Laurent.

confidence.reason: Original articles, the May 2022 minutes and the signed March 2022 contribution deed establish these distinct executive and asset decisions. Income rights are not misrepresented as full ownership or a personal cash payment.
